behavior: Transactions has a records currency select, and each amount shows its value in that currency
acceptance: The transactions schema reads recordsValue {currency, amount, rateDate} or null; the API slice reads and sets the records currency, and setting it reloads the list.

The Export CSV dialog has a Records currency select: USD only, then EUR and each ECB currency but USD with its name; choosing sends PUT .../records-currency (null for USD only) at once; a failure says so and keeps the saved currency.
Each amount with a recordsValue shows it under the amount (both table and phone rows), with the ECB rate date in its tooltip.
Unit tests cover the select's requests and the value line; the live e2e on fixed answers chooses EUR and sees values, axe clean, 390 px fit; DESIGN.md describes it.
notes: 2026-10-19 review fail by reviewer: Blockers: (1) apps/web/src/features/transactions/components/transactions-table.tsx:463-469: the ECB rate date is only a title attribute. Touch users never see it (accept 3 names phone rows), keyboard users cannot reach it, and screen readers often skip it. Fix: use the kit Tooltip (hover, focus, tap; as EstimateHint and ConfirmingStatus do) on a focusable trigger, plus sr-only rate text, or show the date another way; update the e2e check. (2) transactions-table.tsx:468: the API decimal string prints raw, with no thousands grouping ('1234567.89 EUR' under '+1,234,567.89 USDC'; '1734567 KRW'). Fix: format with the currency's decimals from AGREED_CURRENCIES, via formatTokenAmount/Money after parseTokenAmount, or Intl.NumberFormat as formatAgreed does. (3) Accept 4 asks for unit tests of the value line; there are none (records.test.tsx only adds recordsValue: null; proof 4 cites docs-check only). Fix: add a unit test that renders a row with recordsValue in the table and phone list and checks the formatted value and the rate date; it is money display, a kept-test category. Minor: records-currency.tsx error state survives closing and reopening the dialog (the dialog never unmounts; ExportTransactions clears its own error on open); a failed GET leaves the select disabled with no message; Cancel does not undo the instant save (hint says Saved, acceptable); the setting sits behind an icon-only Export button on phones and DESIGN.md does not record why it is in the export dialog; transactions-api.ts repeats { currency: string | null } three times, infer one type from recordsCurrencySchema in types/transactions.ts; recordsCurrencySchema lacks the ^[A-Z]{3}$ pattern recordsValue.currency has; records-currency.tsx:13-20 repeats agreed-value.tsx's code-and-name option mapping; 'USD' literal at records-currency.tsx:18; transactions-table.tsx:449 comment says what, not why; DESIGN.md:191 holds two facts (D-84); tooltip shows an ISO date unlike other dates; no screenshots in docs/runs; proof 1 cites unit for the list reload, only e2e shows it. Fine: USD_ONLY sentinel, tags and invalidation, chosen reset on confirm, failure keeps the saved value, select label and hint, axe, 390 px fit; overview preview shares Amount, bell and command menu show token amounts only, as before.
